meta.title: MetaOntic AI Management Tool
meta.description: MetaOntic AI is a unified AI API gateway aggregating multiple model providers with OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini protocol compatibility. It centralizes account, group and token quotas, separates individual and team allocations, and supports purpose-specific key permissions, limits and expiration, with centralized usage, cost and request records. This plugin uses New API management endpoints to provide a model plaza, API key management, balance and usage queries, subscriptions and recharge.
